result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the first card in 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) displays a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, which is the main visual defect. A secondary minor issue is the low-contrast favorite button sitting on the empty gray placeholder.

issues.description: The hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' failed to load, showing a gray box with a generic broken-image icon. This leaves a large empty area and makes the card look unfinished compared to the other restaurant cards.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading pipeline and provide a graceful fallback (e.g., a branded cuisine illustration or blurred color placeholder) plus a retry mechanism so a broken-image glyph is never shown to users.

issues.description: On the same card, the gray circular favorite (heart) button sits on the light gray placeholder background, giving it weak contrast and making it hard to distinguish; on loaded cards it appears on a dark scrim over the photo.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a consistent semi-opaque dark or white background with a shadow/scrim so it remains legible regardless of the underlying image or placeholder color.
